name: io.github.tonyyang0504/unity_ads-mcp
description: Unity Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UNITY_ADS_KEY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Key ID of a Unity service account (Unity Cloud dashboard > Administration > Service accounts) with an Advertise API role (Viewer for reads, Campaigns Editor or Admin for budget changes); the HTTP Basic username.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UNITY_ADS_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The service account's secret key, the HTTP Basic password.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UNITY_ADS_ORGANIZATION_ID
environmentVariables.description: Unity organization id (core id) that owns the Unity Ads advertiser apps; part of every path.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_UNITY_ADS_CAMPAIGN_SET_ID
environmentVariables.description: App (campaign set) id used by update_budget, since budget calls are addressed as /apps/{campaignSetId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/budget. Take it from list_accounts.
